TeacherAccount.title: TeacherAccount
TeacherAccount.description: Activated teacher or proktor account authorized for Firebase Google Authentication in CBT SD Negeri 4 Lalembuu.

id.description: Unique identifier for the teacher account.

name.description: Full name and academic title of the teacher.

email.description: Google account email address activated for Firebase login.

subject.description: Assigned subject taught by the teacher.

role.description: Role of the account in CBT application.

status.description: Activation status for Firebase Google Authentication.

isDemo.description: Whether this account is a demo account.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator or authenticated teacher.

/teacher_accounts/{teacherId}.description: Stores activated teacher and proktor accounts authorized to sign in via Firebase Google Authentication.
